item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 21/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually in the next few days. It will become humid and foggy over the region, and it will be warm during the day. Under the influence of another northeast monsoon, it will be mainly cloudy over the coastal areas of southern China midweek next week. Temperatures will drop slightly.

R.H. range: 50 - 75 per Cent
